brief: A calendar showing energy levels — mornings are high ground, post-lunch dips are valleys

dominant_strengths: Conceptually fresh — turning each calendar day into a tiny energy bar chart literalizes the 'peaks and valleys' metaphor well
Strong information density per cell without overwhelming; sidebar stats reinforce the daily summary effectively
Clear weekly grid rhythm with a confident dark canvas that lets the saturated bars carry meaning
dominant_weaknesses: Four-bar miniatures repeat near-identically across 30 days, producing visual noise rather than differentiated insight per day
Candy-bright green/yellow/pink/blue palette clashes with the muted gradient title and feels more dashboard than calm wellness tool
Selected day (13) uses a washed pastel overlay that reduces contrast and legibility instead of emphasizing focus
fix_priorities: Vary bar heights meaningfully per day or aggregate to a single sparkline so the metaphor reveals pattern, not repetition
Desaturate palette and reserve one accent for the selected/peak state to restore hierarchy
Redesign the selected-cell treatment with a defined border or elevation rather than a blur wash
Tighten typography scale — date numerals and weekday headers compete; unify weights
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective concept is strong and visceral color is loud, but behavioral clarity suffers because every day looks the same at a glance.
rationale.intent_fit: It does encode morning highs and post-lunch valleys per day, but the metaphor is buried under repetition rather than surfaced as a readable rhythm.
